observations: Photo 0: a used inline petrol engine out of the vehicle, on a dealer's floor, with another engine just behind it.
Photo 0: the valve cover carries the Toyota logo and 'VVT-i' lettering, and a small label near the oil filler cap reads '1TR' followed by a suffix that is not fully legible at this resolution.

Photo 0: a cooling fan blade with fan clutch is fitted at the front, so it is a front-to-back (rear-wheel-drive layout) engine; a power steering pump and its reservoir, accessory belt and pulleys are attached.
Photo 0: intake hose, wiring harness and sensor plugs still on; the engine is dusty but looks complete from this side.
Photo 0: no gearbox, ECU or starter clearly shown; the far side, sump and underside are not visible.
Photo 0: overlaid dealer watermark and a phone camera stamp 'CAMON 40'; no clip of the engine running.

identity.kind: used car engine (Toyota 4 cylinder petrol, 2.0 L class)
read_from: photo 0 Toyota logo on valve cover
photo 0 label beside oil filler cap reading 1TR

claims.claim: Direct Japan (imported used engine from Japan)
claims.evidence: Origin cannot be shown in a photo; would need import or auction paperwork.
A seller's promise; no written guarantee is shown, and it can only be settled by a signed receipt or warranty slip at handover.

risks.risk: Engine code misread: the label is small and the suffix blurry; a 2TR or other engine would change the price.
risks.proof: Sharp close-up of the engine code stamped on the block and of the label on the valve cover.
risks.if_unproven: as the 1TR, the smaller and cheaper of the likely codes

risks.risk: Engine may not run: low compression, knocking, burning oil or overheating history.
risks.proof: Clip of the engine started on a stand: cold start, idle, revving, with the exhaust in view and the seller's handwritten code in shot.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or missing parts on the unseen side: cracked block, broken mounts, missing starter, alternator or ECU.
risks.proof: Photos of the other side, the back and the sump, and of the ancillaries included.
risks.if_unproven: as a long block with only the parts visible in photo 0

risks.risk: Dealer stock photo; the engine sold may not be the one pictured.
risks.proof: Fresh photo of the engine with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we supply.
risks.if_unproven: held to the worst case until the fresh photo arrives

proof_requests: Sharp close-up of the engine code stamp on the block and the label on the valve cover.
Clip of the engine running on a stand, cold start and idle, with exhaust visible.
Photos of all sides and underside of the engine and a list of included parts.
Written guarantee terms on the dealer's receipt.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a Toyota VVT-i engine with a label reading 1TR, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-running 1TR-FE long block. A sharp code close-up and a running clip would raise it.
